authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.field: BL group 92 merge flags; only bits 0x8000 and 0x10000 are documented

implementation.change: The R24 typed writer admits per-cell-style merge flag combinations within mask 0x18000 while preserving all other profile checks.

checks: Raw TABLEFORMAT group-92 values are checked in exact per-style order.
Fresh typed readback compares each merge flag to its source style.
Undocumented bit 0x1 is refused without replacing a destination sentinel; the restored profile then succeeds on the same adapter.
control.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture is committed; output is temporary and removed.

limits: This establishes generated transport and readback of the documented mask only.
Native merge behavior, physical producer profiles, and whole-source conversion remain unqualified.
